facts.text: A Fact requires id, subject_id, kind, text, tags, confidence, status, provenance and content_hash.
A Fact key declares a slot that is unique per subject_id, kind and key among live facts.
at: Unique per (subject_id, kind, key) among live facts

facts.text: Fact text has a soft limit of 240 chars, warns above 280, and is never truncated.
A Fact data payload may hold any JSON value, and its presence makes the fact conflict-eligible.
A stored fact holds only the lifecycle values live, superseded and retracted.
at: A stored fact holds only the lifecycle values live, superseded and retracted

facts.text: An Attachment is a file on disk at blobs/<sha256> and is never kept in the DB.
at: File on disk (blobs/<sha256>), never in the DB

facts.text: Fact items is an optional array of Item objects and is allowed on any fact.
Fact confidence is a number with minimum 0 and maximum 1.
The Fact content_hash pattern requires 64 lowercase hex characters.
Stale and contested are derived from refs at read time and are never stored.
at: stale and contested are derived from refs at read time

facts.text: Published bundles, the change journal and the graph view carry the stored status.
at: the graph view carry the stored status

facts.text: An Attachment perceptual object requires algo and value and allows no other properties.
Provenance origin is an optional string, unlike actor and channel which are required.
Attachment bytes is an integer with minimum 0.
A Ref requires rel, kind, target and basis.
Ref kind is an open string where fact, slot and subject are internal and every other kind is external.
at: fact|slot|subject are internal; all others external

facts.text: Ref seq is an integer that orders a ref within a chain.
Locator bbox is an array of exactly 4 numbers, described as [x, y, w, h].
Locator line is an integer with minimum 1.
A symbol ref whose target has no revision is rejected with symbol_target_requires_revision.
Ref verified_at is a string in date-time format.
For kind=slot the target is written as subjectIdOrName, then #, then the key.
A Subject parent is the subject id of the parent subject.
at: Subject id of the parent subject

facts.text: Subject aliases is an array of strings.
Pin repo and rev are each strings with minLength 1.
A Dossier requires subject, depth, needs, budget_tokens, used_tokens, facts, linked, conflicts, gaps, dropped and self_check.
In complete mode every fact is emitted and budget_tokens is only the highlight threshold, so used_tokens may exceed it.
at: budget_tokens is only the highlight threshold

facts.text: Rank order puts every stale fact after every fact that is not stale.
at: every stale fact after every fact that is not stale

facts.text: In strict mode facts are cut to the budget and the rest is listed in dropped.
at: facts are cut to the budget

facts.text: linked is built from follow and gets a separate budget slice of roughly 25%.
Each conflicts entry requires field, values and resolution, and resolution is typed null.
Each gaps entry requires need and reason, both strings.
FactView is one object used by both search hits and dossier facts, with optional fields null when not applicable.
at: One object used by BOTH search hits and dossier facts

facts.text: FactView why appears only when status is stale or contested and lists the refs that make it so.
at: only when status is stale or contested

facts.text: A FactView requires id, subject_id, kind, text, tags, confidence and status.
Dossier needs is an array of strings.
self_check requires uncited_claims and conflicts_surfaced.
The manifest format is the constant dossier-jsonl/1.
Manifest files is an array of file names that is sorted ordinally and unique.
Manifest counts requires subjects, facts and assets.
Manifest options requires assets, max_file_bytes, max_files, max_total_bytes, subject and subject_id.
Manifest options assets is one of embed, files or none.
Manifest options profile is a string with minLength 1.
A manifest FileName is manifest.json, a dossier-NNNN.jsonl file or an assets path holding a sha256.
bundle_hash references the Sha256 definition.
Manifest assets maps each sha256 to an AssetEntry object.
A JSONL record line is one of SubjectRecord, FactRecord or AssetRecord.
SubjectRecord path is the subject's tree path, the slug path, in the bundle.
at: The subject's tree path (slug path) in the bundle

facts.text: bundle_key is the content-addressed key the markdown bundle names this fact by.
at: The content-addressed key the markdown bundle names this fact by

facts.text: Each attachment blob appears once per sha256, either embedded as base64, written to assets/ or reported missing.
at: embedded as base64, written to assets/, or reported missing

facts.text: AssetMissing missing is the constant true.
The JSONL record Sha256 definition is a string matching the pattern of 64 lowercase hex characters.
FactRecord subject_name is a string with minLength 1.
AssetFile path matches assets/ then 64 hex characters and an optional lowercase extension.
AssetEmbedded data is standard base64 of the blob and its sha256 must equal the record sha256.
AssetEmbedded encoding is the constant base64.
